children: The Parallax Chain is a secret society of independent captains who deal in the most reviled criminal activity in the galaxy. Most are not outright slavers, but they are willing to deal with those who trade in lives for profit. The Chain uses scouts as spies and informants. Even during the Empire's peak, when slavers were able to operate almost openly, the Chain hides and keeps an eye out for opportunities to make profit. The Chain values new planets either to exploit for slaves or to use as hideaways for valuable hostages it plans to sell back to wealthy parents and corporations.
